Terms of Service

Last updated: August 2026

1. Service Coordination Scope

SolarSite Co. acts as a professional coordination and quality-assurance platform connecting Solar EPCs, dealers, and contractors with vetted independent field site surveyors.

2. Turnaround Times & SLAs

Standard residential site survey packages are scheduled within 48 hours of intake and delivered within 48–72 hours following field completion, subject to weather conditions, customer property access, and safe climbing environments.

3. Deliverable Acceptance & QA

All delivered survey packages undergo internal desk QA. If an essential photo or measurement specified in our 36-photo standard is missing or unreadable due to surveyor error, a re-dispatch will be conducted at no additional charge to the EPC.

4. Limitation of Liability

Survey data and preliminary electrical calculations are provided to assist the contractor’s licensed Professional Engineer (PE) and CAD draftspersons. Final structural and electrical designs remain the legal responsibility of the licensed engineer of record and installing contractor.
